title: Limestone for the sills
Stone for the terraces of {settlement}
summary: The houses of {settlement} sit on limestone sills cut into the towers. The {place} wants {count} × {item} for its sill and steps.
A new terrace climbs the stone in {settlement}, and it needs {count} × {item} to hold the {place}.
offer: Every house here stands on a shelf we cut and build up. The {place}'s shelf is half-made: {count} × {item}, and we will raise it.
The terraces go up one ledge at a time, and we are out of stone for the next. {count} × {item}, please.
progress: Bring the stone when you can; the mountain is patient.
complete: The ledge will hold. Come back and see the {place} when it stands.
Good stone. The terrace climbs again.
